questions.explanation:
In one Mg3(PO4)2 molecule no of oxygen atoms = 8

So if there is M mole of Mg3(PO4)2 molecules then no of moles of oxygen atoms is = M 8

According to question,

M 8 = 0.25

M = 0.03125 = 3.125 10-2
